newsitem.title: USA: ITC probes patent infringement -Personalized Media.
newsitem.headline: ITC probes patent infringement -Personalized Media.

text.p: Personalized Media Communications LLC said on Monday the U.S. International Trade Commission has started an investigation of five manufacturers of Digital Satellite System receivers based on a claim of patent infringement by Personalized Media.
The manufacturers include affiliates of Thomson SA, Hughes Electronics Corp, Hitachi Ltd, Toshiba Corp and Matsushita Electric Industrial Co Ltd.

Personalized also said it filed a lawsuit charging patent infringement against DirecTV, U.S. Satellite and the five named Digital Satellite manufacturers in the U.S. District Court for the Northern District of California in San Jose.

The commission is also investigating infringement charges Personalized has made against Hughes' DirectTV Inc and U.S. Satellite Broadcasting Co for allegedly providing signals to allegedly unlawful receivers, the company said.

It said the manufacturers may have violated the Tariff Act of 1930 through the importation, sale for importation, and sale in the United States after importation, of DSS receivers that infringe its U.S. patent.

If the ITC supported Personalized's claim, the commission could issue a permanent exclusion order banning importation into the U.S. of the receivers and a cease and desist order directed to all five named Digital Satellite manufacturers.
Also, Personalized said the commission could issue a permanent order to DirecTV and U.S. Satellite to cease and desist providing signals to unlawfully imported receivers.
The ITC is undertaking this investigation based on a complaint filed November 13 by Personalized.
